class Mentor:
    def __init__(self, aName):
        self._name = aName
        self._myStudents = []

    def setName(self, aName):
        self._name = aName
        return True

    def getName(self):
        return self._name

    def getMyStudent(self, index):
        return self._myStudents[index]

    def getMyStudents(self):
        return tuple(self._myStudents)

    def numberOfMyStudents(self):
        return len(self._myStudents)

    def hasMyStudents(self):
        return len(self._myStudents) > 0

    def indexOfMyStudent(self, aMyStudent):
        return next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._myStudents) if x is aMyStudent), -1)

    @staticmethod
    def minimumNumberOfMyStudents():
        return 0

    def addMyStudent(self, aMyStudent):
        if any(x is aMyStudent for x in self._myStudents):
            return False
        self._myStudents.append(aMyStudent)
        if aMyStudent.indexOfProf(self) == -1 and not aMyStudent.addProf(self):
            del self._myStudents[next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._myStudents) if x is aMyStudent), -1)]
            return False
        self._myStudents.sort(key=lambda x: x.getId())
        return True

    def removeMyStudent(self, aMyStudent):
        oldIndex = next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._myStudents) if x is aMyStudent), -1)
        if oldIndex == -1:
            return False
        del self._myStudents[oldIndex]
        if aMyStudent.indexOfProf(self) != -1 and not aMyStudent.removeProf(self):
            self._myStudents.insert(oldIndex, aMyStudent)
            return False
        return True

    def delete(self):
        copyOfMyStudents = tuple(self._myStudents)
        self._myStudents.clear()
        for aMyStudent in copyOfMyStudents:
            aMyStudent.removeProf(self)

    def __str__(self):
        return (super().__str__() + "["
                + "name:" + str(self.getName())
                + "]")
